profile.headline:
Lead Software Engineer, @ BloomNet, 1800-Flowers, Inc.
|| FAA Certified Flight Instructor: CFI, CFI-I, MEI, Commercial Pilot
|| Adjunct Professor of Business & Economics at York College of the City University of New York
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Over 17 years of experience in N-Tier enterprise level, e-commerce software and client-server applications.

Active in software development and take on the role as solution architect.
Leadership (of a team of software engineers): Resource allocation and management, Project management

Familiar with software development methodologies, with in-depth experience using object oriented design and techniques; Always strive to implement optimized, efficient and effective software code implementation.

Team leader demonstrating leadership abilities and teamwork collaboration expertise working with both technical and non-technical teams: Requirement analysis, timeline, resource allocation, and team management.

Ability to accomplish tasks under minimal direction and supervision.

Web Development using: 
--------------------------------------------
Microsoft.NET Framework (6.0, 5.0, 4.8.*, 4.7.*, 4.5.*) - C# language
Entity Framework 6, 5, 4.1; Database First / Code-First Migrations, Also Familiar with traditional ADO.NET
ASP.NET C#- MVC, Web-forms, WebAPI
MS SignalR
Other Web Technologies including (JavaScript, KnockOut.js, jQuery, Xml, Xslt, XHtml, HTML 5, 4 & CSS 3, 2)
Various code repository platforms including Git (GitHub, BitBucket, etc.), MS Foundation Server, Subversion, etc.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Development Manager
positions.description:
Manages a team of software engineers
Supervises, manages, designs/implements, maintains the POS (Point of Sales) and related systems use by retailed florists across the US Nation that has monthly average of multi-millions USD in transactions.

• Proficient with: .NET 6, .NET 5, 4.8.*, 4.7.* ; 4.6.* ; 4.0;  Entity Framework 6, 5, with C#. 
• MS.NET technologies - SignalR, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web-API as well as Web-Forms
• Other web technologies including Knockout.js, jQuery, HTML 5, 4.1, 4; CSS 3, 2, Telerik Kendo UI, Telerik Asp.net Ajax Controls, etc.

• Service oriented (SOA); separation of concern patterned N-Tier web-based POS system is/will be used by a growing number of 10,000+ Retail Florists nationwide 7 days a week.

• Full feature cloud-based retail store PCI-Compliant  POS system, include but not limited to: POS hardware controls (printer, barcode scanner, card reader, etc.), Credit Card payment processing, Automatic order receive & printing, information encryption, delivery routings, delivery planning, processing of orders forwarded from 1800Flowers.com website, Reporting (sales summary/details, Orders by types, Wire Order Services, Rewards rewarded, Open Orders, Orders by zip, Credit Card approval records, etc.)

• Utilize Telerik Asp.Net AJAX and Telerik reporting controls. Methods chaining via .Net Delegates and Decorators architecture

• Database access methods implement in DataSet/DataTable based architecture using DataAdapters; Code/Model-First, Database-First approach using .Net Entity Framework & Linq-to-Entities, Linq-to-SQL
Message Queuing, Brokerage, Data Caching utilizing SQL server broker.

positions.title: Certified Flight Instructor (CFI, CFII, MEI)
positions.locationName: Atlantic Terminal, Republic Airport (KFRG) - Farmingdale, New York
positions.description:
• Certified Flight Instructor (CFI), Certified Flight Instructor – Instrument (CFI-I), Multi-Engine Instructor (MEI)
• Advanced Ground Instructor (AGI), Instrument Ground Instructor (IGI)

• Educates and trains FAA pilot certificate candidates for: Commercial Pilot, Instrument Rating and Private Pilot certificates (Both Single Engine and Multi-Engine Aircrafts)

• Conducts 14 CFR 61.56 Flight Reviews to licensed pilots (commercial & private) and 14 CFR 61.57 (d) Instrument Proficiency Check for instrument-rated pilots.

• Proficient with “6-packs” gauges and advanced avionics including Garmin G1000, G1000 NXI, Garmin G600, G500, Aspen Evolution 1000 Max PFD & MFD.

Familiar with (Aircrafts Flown):
---------------------------------------------------------
• [Beechcraft]: Duchess BE-76 (Multi-Engine)
• [Piper]: Archer II & III (PA28-181), Cherokee Warrior II & III (PA28-161)
• [Cessna]: Stationair (C206), Turbo Skylane (T182T - G1000), Skylane (C182), Skyhawks: 172SP (G1000), 172S, 172M, 172N
• [CubCrafter]: Sport Cub 2 (CC11-100 Tailwheel)

company.name: Global Aviation Corp. (Part 61 & Part 141 Flight School)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Manager of Department Applications, Department of Anesthesiology
positions.description:
Worked closely with the clinical and research teams led by medical doctors
•	Clinical Research:  Research Outcome Evaluation & Prediction Applications.
•	MDs, PAs, CRNAs, Residents, Fellows Scheduling Applications.
•	PACU Notes; Patients Record Management Application.
•	Medical Residents/Fellows Evaluation & Interviewing Application. 
•	Medical Society & Committee Meetings Scheduling Applications, etc.

•	Algorithmic & interface designs, implements, manages & maintains all departmental desktop & web applications such as those listed above.

•	Conducts ongoing research to improve and to maximize applications’ accuracy, efficiency & effectiveness with the latest technologies.

•	 Administers and manages anesthesia department servers.

•	Ensures clinical research & department software applications are adhered to hospital’s privacy and security practices.

•	Establishes policies, procedures and standards to measure and monitor clinical research & department applications, databases and production processes. Continually strives to improve existing policies, procedures and standards.

positions.title: Project Manager, Web Products Manager, Software Engineer
positions.description:
• XML, XSL, JavaScript, JQuery, Prototype, 

• ASP.NET C# (framework 2.0, 3.5), ADO.NET, T-SQL.
Developed middle-tier, front-tier software modules, components and routines using c# programming language.

• Web Application + Web Service Development using latest modern  technology including MS .NET framework, JQuery & Prototype frameworks

• MCTS in .NET - Windows Application Development

• MCTS in .NET – Web Application Development

positions.title: .NET developer at SetFocus LLC Masters Program
positions.description:
Developed Real-World Multi-Tier application using .NET framework, 

Multiple interface including local windows form and web-enabled asp.net web form connected to a central databases.

Triggers, stored procedures written in Transact SQL language.

positions.title: TA / Tutor / Substitute / Lab Technician
positions.description:
TA, tutor, proctor, lecturer in the Computer Science Department with main focus on Algorithm Design & Analysis and Data Structures Design and Development.

Lectured CS courses including Data Structures (C++), Object Oriented Programming (Java, C++), etc.

Researched topics include cryptographic algorithm development, and sought solutions to non-polynomial problems and algorithm developments.
